title: Beta Data Coverage
text: This explorer is currently in Beta with limited coverage. The 'Science' register is restricted to English and select models. Select GPT-4, to access multilingual data in the News register.

title: Methodology: Volume
text: Volume is based on the Lexical Alignment Score (LAS), which is derived from windowed document prevalence analysis. It offers a fully automated metric for divergence, eliminating the need for manual curation. Details in the About section.

title: Methodology: Spiking
text: Spiking is based on the Log Prevalence Ratio (LPR). It measures the magnitude of overuse and identifies 'spiking hallmark' words of AI.

title: Deep Dive
text: Toggle the Table View to inspect the specific Part-of-Speech (POS) tags for every divergent word found in the dataset. OPM is occurrences per million (tokens).
